learning_outcomes.text: OOP at the level of RAD programming languages.
Master the practical application of OOP.

syllabus_topics: Introduction into running applications in the computer laboratory, students' accounts, students will be submitted 3 practical excercises to solve.
Simple application. Constants. Simple types, structured types incl. arrays, records, sets, files. Variables. Basics of programming language.
Sorting. Handling events (OnMouse.., Timer). Using components, their fields and attributes.
Dynamic data structures: stack, queue, linked list, tree.
Training in the Java NetBeans environment.
assessment_rules: The exam has practical and oral parts. The practical part of the exam is to write and debug a simple program on a given task. For assessment, the student receives three tasks to program.
